comparison.objective: Find polarizer extinction and power down; no task rubric or spec version is included.
comparison.physical_skill: Rotate/adjust an optical element while observing an intensity minimum, then operate power control.
comparison.success_condition: Extinction is found and the apparatus is powered down; quantitative extinction and pose thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Optical optimization and shutdown are meaningfully different from mechanical impact fracture and fragment handling.
